proposal.reason: Main change is communicator-level config surface: new config fields are validated/defaulted/env-overridden, stored, and synchronized across ranks during init. Add device-topology because src/graph/paths.cc substantively changes P2P channel computation using nChannelsPerNetPeer/maxP2pPeers (including caps and tuning logic). Add enqueue because strongstream/graph-mixing behavior and P2P plan channel-limiting logic are changed in runtime planning/execution paths, not just call-site churn.
